description: Deployments: the internal layouts of boxes. A Deployment is of one box, its Component, and kept in a Component, its keeper: the box itself, or another, such as a plug-in package. It is abstract: its Instances are placements, real only where a real Instance runs it; an Instance may run a fixed Deployment of its box, or leave the choice to a Configuration. Connections are the layout's structure, through interfaces: from an Instance to an Instance whose box offers the Interactions, to an identity the Deployment imports, or out through the box. A Deployment's Imports are its needs; it exposes some of its placements, as APIs. An identity is a path of exposed placements from the root, one Step each. A box with no Deployment is an interface. Extends Contexts.

axioms.about: An Instance's min <= max, where max is present
axioms.formula: all i in Instance, m in i.max. i.min <= m

axioms.about: An Instance is of a box in its Deployment's scope: a child of its box or of the box's ancestors, a child of its keeper or of the keeper's ancestors, or a top-level Component the Deployment imports
axioms.formula: all i in Instance, d in i.deployment. i.of in d.component.*parent.components or i.of in d.keeper.*parent.components or (no i.of.parent and i.of in d.imports.from)

axioms.about: An Instance runs only a Deployment of its own box
axioms.formula: all i in Instance, r in i.runs. r.component == i.of

axioms.about: No two Instances of a Deployment share a name
axioms.formula: all a in Instance, b in Instance. (a != b and a.deployment == b.deployment) => a.name != b.name

axioms.about: A Deployment kept outside its box imports the box
axioms.formula: all d in Deployment. d.keeper == d.component or d.component in d.imports.from or d.component in d.imports.exports.component

axioms.about: A Connection goes from an Instance of its own Deployment
axioms.formula: all c in Connection. c.from.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: A Connection goes to exactly one thing: an Instance, an identity, or the Deployment's box
axioms.formula: all c in Connection. (some c.to and no c.toComponent and no c.toIdentity) or (no c.to and some c.toComponent and no c.toIdentity) or (no c.to and no c.toComponent and some c.toIdentity)

axioms.about: A Connection goes to an Instance of its own Deployment
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, t in c.to. t.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: A Connection to a Component goes to the Deployment's box
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, k in c.toComponent. k == c.deployment.component

axioms.about: A Connection to an identity goes to one its Deployment imports
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, m in c.toIdentity. m.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: The Instance a Connection goes to offers its What: its own, or one of an API it exports
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, t in c.to. i.component == t.of or i.component in t.of.exports.component

axioms.about: The box a Connection goes out through offers its What, or the Deployment imports it
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, k in c.toComponent. i.component == k or i.component in k.exports.component or i in c.deployment.imports.exports.interaction

axioms.about: The identity a Connection goes to offers its What
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, m in c.toIdentity, s in m.steps. no s.next => (i.component == s.instance.of or i.component in s.instance.of.exports.component)

axioms.about: A Connection's What is over one Language
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, a in c.what, b in c.what. a.language == b.language

axioms.about: An Import belongs to exactly one Component or Deployment
axioms.formula: all m in Import. (some m.importer and no m.deployment) or (no m.importer and some m.deployment)

axioms.about: An Import is from a Component, or is an identity
axioms.formula: all m in Import. (some m.from and no m.steps) or (no m.from and some m.steps)

axioms.about: An identity takes no Exports
axioms.formula: all m in Import. some m.steps => no m.exports

axioms.about: Only a Deployment imports an identity
axioms.formula: all m in Import. some m.steps => some m.deployment

axioms.about: A Step's next is a Step of the same identity
axioms.formula: all s in Step, n in s.next. n.import == s.import

axioms.about: An identity's Steps have one first
axioms.formula: all m in Import, a in m.steps, b in m.steps. (no a.previous and no b.previous) => a == b

axioms.about: The Step chain has no cycles
axioms.formula: all s in Step. not s in s.^next

axioms.about: Each Step after the first is placed in a Deployment of the box the Step before it is of
axioms.formula: all s in Step, n in s.next. n.instance.deployment.component == s.instance.of

axioms.about: Each Step is a placement its Deployment exposes
axioms.formula: all s in Step. s.instance in s.instance.deployment.exposes.instance

axioms.about: An Export belongs to exactly one Component or Deployment
axioms.formula: all e in Export. (some e.exporter and no e.exposer) or (no e.exporter and some e.exposer)

axioms.about: A Deployment exposes only placements, its own
axioms.formula: all e in Export, x in e.exposer. some e.instance and e.instance.deployment == x

axioms.about: Only a Deployment exposes a placement
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.instance => some e.exposer

axioms.about: An Export of a placement exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.instance => no e.component and no e.interaction and no e.transformation and no e.language and no e.deployment

axioms.about: An Export of a Deployment exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.deployment => no e.component and no e.interaction and no e.transformation and no e.language

axioms.about: A Component exports only Deployments it keeps
axioms.formula: all e in Export, d in e.deployment. d.keeper == e.exporter
